tasks.label: inspect-files
tasks.command: Get-Content servicehub-api/pom.xml; Get-Content servicehub-api/src/main/resources/application.properties; Get-Content servicehub-api/src/main/java/com/servicehub/servicehub_api/model/Servico.java; Get-Content servicehub-api/src/main/java/com/servicehub/servicehub_api/service/ServicoService.java; Get-Content servicehub-api/src/main/java/com/servicehub/servicehub_api/controler/ServicoController.java; Get-Content servicehub-api/src/test/java/com/servicehub/servicehub_api/ServicehubApiApplicationTests.java

tasks.label: baseline-status-test
tasks.command: git status --short; Get-Content README.md; Set-Location servicehub-api; mvn test

tasks.label: inspect-more
tasks.command: Get-Content servicehub-api/src/main/java/com/servicehub/servicehub_api/ServicehubApiApplication.java; Get-Content servicehub-api/src/main/java/com/servicehub/servicehub_api/repository/ServicoRepository.java; Get-Content servicehub-api/mvnw.cmd

tasks.label: compile-step1
tasks.command: Set-Location servicehub-api; .\mvnw.cmd -q -DskipTests compile

tasks.label: test-step2
tasks.command: Set-Location servicehub-api; .\mvnw.cmd test

tasks.label: test-step3
tasks.command: Set-Location servicehub-api; .\mvnw.cmd test

tasks.label: read-test-errors
tasks.command: Get-ChildItem servicehub-api/target/surefire-reports/*.txt | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ('--- '+$_.Name); Select-String -Path $_.FullName -Pattern 'Caused by:|IllegalArgumentException|BeanCreationException|Failed to instantiate' -Context 0,3 }

tasks.label: inspect-packages
tasks.command: Get-ChildItem servicehub-api/src/main/java/com/servicehub/servicehub_api -Recurse -Filter *.java | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ('--- '+$_.FullName); Get-Content $_.FullName -TotalCount 2 }

tasks.label: test-step4
tasks.command: Set-Location servicehub-api; .\mvnw.cmd test

tasks.label: test-step5
tasks.command: Set-Location servicehub-api; .\mvnw.cmd test -q

tasks.label: final-verify
tasks.command: Set-Location servicehub-api; .\mvnw.cmd clean test -q; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Write-Output 'MAVEN_EXIT=0' } else { Write-Output ('MAVEN_EXIT='+$LASTEXITCODE) }; Get-ChildItem target/surefire-reports/*.txt | ForEach-Object { Select-String -Path $_.FullName -Pattern 'Tests run:' }

tasks.label: final-test-dtos
tasks.command: Set-Location servicehub-api; .\mvnw.cmd test -q; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Write-Output 'MAVEN_EXIT=0' } else { Write-Output ('MAVEN_EXIT='+$LASTEXITCODE) }; Get-ChildItem target/surefire-reports/*.txt | ForEach-Object { Select-String -Path $_.FullName -Pattern 'Tests run:' }

tasks.label: check-env-and-usage
tasks.command: $p='servicehub-api'; Write-Output '--- references ---'; Select-String -Path "$p/src/main/resources/application.properties","$p/src/main/java/**/*.java" -Pattern 'SERVICEHUB_DB_PASSWORD|SERVICEHUB_JWT_SECRET|servicehub.jwt.secret' -SimpleMatch -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { "$($_.Path):$($_.LineNumber):$($_.Line -replace '(SERVICEHUB_DB_PASSWORD|SERVICEHUB_JWT_SECRET)=?[^} ]*','$1=<redacted>')" }; Write-Output '--- env presence ---'; foreach($n in 'SERVICEHUB_DB_PASSWORD','SERVICEHUB_JWT_SECRET'){ $v=[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($n,'Process'); $u=[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($n,'User'); $m=[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($n,'Machine'); Write-Output ("{0}: Process={1}; User={2}; Machine={3}" -f $n, [bool]$v, [bool]$u, [bool]$m) }

tasks.label: check-env-and-usage-2
tasks.command: Write-Output '--- references ---'; Select-String -Path 'servicehub-api/src/main/resources/application.properties','servicehub-api/src/main/java/**/*.java' -Pattern 'SERVICEHUB_DB_PASSWORD','SERVICEHUB_JWT_SECRET','servicehub.jwt.secret' -SimpleMatch -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ($_.Path + ':' + $_.LineNumber) }; Write-Output '--- env presence ---'; foreach($n in @('SERVICEHUB_DB_PASSWORD','SERVICEHUB_JWT_SECRET')) { $v=[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($n,'Process'); $u=[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($n,'User'); $m=[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($n,'Machine'); Write-Output ($n + ': Process=' + [bool]$v + '; User=' + [bool]$u + '; Machine=' + [bool]$m) }

tasks.label: configure-local-jwt
tasks.command: $existing=[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('SERVICEHUB_JWT_SECRET','User'); if(-not $existing){ $bytes=New-Object byte[] 48; [Security.Cryptography.RandomNumberGenerator]::Fill($bytes); $generated=[Convert]::ToBase64String($bytes); [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('SERVICEHUB_JWT_SECRET',$generated,'User'); Write-Output 'JWT_SECRET_ACTION=generated-and-saved-to-user-environment' } else { Write-Output 'JWT_SECRET_ACTION=already-present-user-environment' }; $check=[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('SERVICEHUB_JWT_SECRET','User'); Write-Output ('JWT_SECRET_PRESENT=' + [bool]$check); Write-Output ('JWT_SECRET_LENGTH_OK=' + ($check.Length -ge 32))

tasks.label: generate-local-jwt-compatible
tasks.command: $bytes=New-Object byte[] 48; $rng=New-Object Security.Cryptography.RNGCryptoServiceProvider; $rng.GetBytes($bytes); $rng.Dispose(); $generated=[Convert]::ToBase64String($bytes); [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('SERVICEHUB_JWT_SECRET',$generated,'User'); $check=[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('SERVICEHUB_JWT_SECRET','User'); Write-Output 'JWT_SECRET_ACTION=generated-and-saved-to-user-environment'; Write-Output ('JWT_SECRET_PRESENT=' + [bool]$check); Write-Output ('JWT_SECRET_LENGTH_OK=' + ($check.Length -ge 32))

tasks.label: start-servicehub-api
tasks.command: $env:SERVICEHUB_DB_PASSWORD=[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('SERVICEHUB_DB_PASSWORD','User'); $env:SERVICEHUB_JWT_SECRET=[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('SERVICEHUB_JWT_SECRET','User'); Set-Location servicehub-api; .\mvnw.cmd spring-boot:run

tasks.label: probe-swagger
tasks.command: try { $r=Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://localhost:8080/swagger-ui.html' -UseBasicParsing -MaximumRedirection 0 -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Output ('HTTP=' + [int]$r.StatusCode); Write-Output ('CONTENT_LENGTH=' + $r.RawContentLength) } catch { if($_.Exception.Response){ Write-Output ('HTTP=' + [int]$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode) } else { Write-Output ('ERROR=' + $_.Exception.Message) } }

tasks.label: diagnose-java-processes
tasks.command: Get-Process java,javaw,mvn,mvnd -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object ProcessName,Id,StartTime

tasks.label: check-port-and-java
tasks.command: Write-Output '--- port 8080 ---'; Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8080 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,OwningProcess; Write-Output '--- java commands ---'; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='java.exe'" | Select-Object ProcessId,CommandLine

tasks.label: verify-swagger-http
tasks.command: $r=Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://localhost:8080/swagger-ui.html' -UseBasicParsing -MaximumRedirection 0 -TimeoutSec 10; Write-Output ('HTTP=' + [int]$r.StatusCode); Write-Output ('CONTENT_LENGTH=' + $r.RawContentLength)

tasks.label: diagnose-port-process
tasks.command: $p=Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8080 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty OwningProcess; Write-Output ('PID=' + $p); if($p){ Get-Process -Id $p | Select-Object ProcessName,Id,Path,StartTime }

tasks.label: restart-servicehub-with-env
tasks.command: $p=Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8080 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty OwningProcess; if($p){ Stop-Process -Id $p -Force }; $env:SERVICEHUB_DB_PASSWORD=[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('SERVICEHUB_DB_PASSWORD','User'); $env:SERVICEHUB_JWT_SECRET=[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('SERVICEHUB_JWT_SECRET','User'); Set-Location servicehub-api; .\mvnw.cmd spring-boot:run

tasks.label: restart-after-jwt-diagnostic
tasks.command: $p=Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8080 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty OwningProcess; if($p){ Stop-Process -Id $p -Force }; $env:SERVICEHUB_DB_PASSWORD=[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('SERVICEHUB_DB_PASSWORD','User'); $env:SERVICEHUB_JWT_SECRET=[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('SERVICEHUB_JWT_SECRET','User'); Set-Location servicehub-api; .\mvnw.cmd spring-boot:run

tasks.label: restart-after-filter-diagnostic
tasks.command: $p=Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8080 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty OwningProcess; if($p){ Stop-Process -Id $p -Force }; $env:SERVICEHUB_DB_PASSWORD=[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('SERVICEHUB_DB_PASSWORD','User'); $env:SERVICEHUB_JWT_SECRET=[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('SERVICEHUB_JWT_SECRET','User'); Set-Location servicehub-api; .\mvnw.cmd spring-boot:run

tasks.label: start-final-api
tasks.command: $env:SERVICEHUB_DB_PASSWORD=[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('SERVICEHUB_DB_PASSWORD','User'); $env:SERVICEHUB_JWT_SECRET=[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('SERVICEHUB_JWT_SECRET','User'); Set-Location servicehub-api; .\mvnw.cmd spring-boot:run

tasks.label: replace-api-instance
tasks.command: $p=Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8080 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty OwningProcess; if($p){ Stop-Process -Id $p -Force; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }; $env:SERVICEHUB_DB_PASSWORD=[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('SERVICEHUB_DB_PASSWORD','User'); $env:SERVICEHUB_JWT_SECRET=[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('SERVICEHUB_JWT_SECRET','User'); Set-Location servicehub-api; .\mvnw.cmd spring-boot:run
